text_block_list.text: Christmas Eve, after training finished.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what plans tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then I grant honor of going out 
together with me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well then, farewell for now―!
Got meetup details later, and next day…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Quite early, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
I thought Bakushin O would get here with 
her usual speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! Honors student class president 
after all!
choice_data_list:
But, I thought you said an hour ago was 
early.

text_block_list.text: Meetup set for 11:00. Current time 10:00.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Speed is good―rather, early is good! 
Onward with haste!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, understand excitement, but calm 
down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Learned how to spend Christmas properly 
and exemplarily!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Precisely! Read magazine classmate had!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If exemplary way to spend day, must put 
into practice immediately!

Slightly worried about classmate magazine 
source, but went along quietly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: First, lunch! Spot should be near…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait wait, right there! Brick building 
Italian restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Very Italian atmosphere! Few people 
around, like secret hideaway!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because it's still early?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No problem! Early-speedy lunch!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's gooo―!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmm～… ♪ Deee-licious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Dessert so sweet, felt like magic spell 
cast on it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Clearly could not hide class president 
aura even here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heart-shaped plate service… Felt 
waitress's immense trust in class 
president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Next, shopping! Recall magazine stating 
general goods store is proper stop!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, nothing specific wanted right now. 
But if exemplary spot, must check!

Looked at Christmas goods in shop, watched 
illuminations…

Spent whole day out with Sakura Bakushin 
O.
Then, finished dinner…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, truly fun day! Utterly exemplary, 
no?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Clear last itinerary item for perfect 
score! Last item is……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right! Embrace beneath starry night sky!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ……Wait, embrace? Eeeh, why!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Written clearly, definitely, undeniably! 
Did I misread?!
choice_data_list: Wasn't today a plan for a date, though?

text_block_list.text:
Looking back on schedule, classic standard 
date course.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Date?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer and I were on date whole time?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaaaahh――?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Date! No way no way no way, impossible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Class president engaging in improper 
conduct?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O, total disgrace today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What to dooo! Cannot face classmates!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, summoned to guidance office 
tomorrow?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Betrayed everyone's trust, branded failed 
class president forever―?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what to dooo～?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Eh!
choice_data_list:
I didn't see any students getting carried 
away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ohhh～!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right! Zero improper intentions!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Understood!

And so, spent wholesome Christmas with 
Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ――Well, totally fine then!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Since with Trainer, not improper 
relationship at all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In fact, purest bond possible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Embrace forbidden for class president, so 
giving special present instead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Look! Notebook planner!

Sakura Bakushin O gave schedule organizer 
for management work.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Needed before new year begins! Brilliant 
and thoughtful class president always 
provides!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I even filled in schedule for you! Here 
are future race plans!

Flipped through pages and saw G1, G1, G1…… 
Chock-full schedule of races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For now thinking we enter every race, but 
book appointment to hash it out with you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Canceling appointments is Miracle-no-go! 
Let's Bakushin together next year too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fufuu, very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …Aaaahhh―? Already so late?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, absolutely cannot 
break curfew!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's Bakushin, Trainer! Lead you along 
this time, just for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, give hand!

…And thus, noisy yet joyful Christmas 
night went on.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's・Bakushiiiin!
